entities.statement: MAI-DxO reaches 85.5% diagnostic accuracy on SDBench vs ~20% for 21 generalist physicians, at ~70% lower cost than bare o3.
Baichuan-M2 (32B) scores >32 on HealthBench Hard, best open-source and previously exceeded only by GPT-5.
Baichuan-M3 significantly outperforms GPT-5.2 in clinical inquiry, advisory and safety (numbers not in abstract).
MedGemma 27B scores 87.7% on MedQA at ~1/10 the inference cost of DeepSeek-R1; MedGemma 1.5 adds 3D/WSI/EHR gains.
AMIE is non-inferior to and on several axes better than 21 PCPs in blinded virtual OSCE disease-management scenarios.
Med-RLVR: reasoning emerges from a 3B base via RLVR, matching SFT in-distribution and +8 points out-of-distribution.
Multi-agent collaboration does NOT consistently beat strong single LLMs or specialized classical ML.
General and medical LLMs still fail to beat SVM/XGBoost on structured clinical prediction.
Best medical MLLM scores ~65% vs 96% human on trivial perceptual checks (orientation/contrast).
Pillar-0 (native-volumetric radiology FM) beats MedGemma/MedImageInsight/Lingshu/Merlin by 7.8-15.8 AUROC, best on 319/366 tasks.
Atlas 2 is SOTA across 80 public pathology benchmarks jointly on prediction, robustness AND resource efficiency.
MOOZY beats TITAN (+5.5-7.8%) and PRISM (+8.8-10.7%) with 85.8M params, 14x smaller than Prov-GigaPath.
2D foundation models surpass 3D architectures for 3D classification, and general FMs match medical-specific FMs once adapted.
Scanner-induced domain shift degrades pathology FM embedding alignment and calibration even when AUC looks stable.
Diffusion priors underperform expectations for real CT reconstruction under correlated noise/geometry; reconstruction is not solved.
Boltz-2 is the first ML model to approach FEP-level binding-affinity accuracy while ~1000x cheaper.
Pearl improves +14.5% (Runs N' Poses) and +14.2% (PoseBusters) over next-best co-folding vs AF3.
Protenix-v1 is the first fully open-source predictor to outperform AF3 at the same data cutoff, scale and inference budget.
RFdiffusion2 scaffolds all 41 enzyme active sites in a benchmark (vs 16/41 prior DL) via atomized-motif flow matching.
Chai-2 achieves ~16% zero-shot de novo antibody hit rate (>100x prior), >=1 hit for 50% of 52 targets with <=20 designs.
ESM3 (98B) generated esmGFP at 58% identity to nearest natural fluorescent protein ('500M years of evolution').
BioEmu emulates equilibrium ensembles up to 100,000x faster than MD, capturing cryptic pockets & free energies to ~1 kcal/mol.
On cross-docking, AI (co-folding/DL) defeats physics-based approaches.
Evo 2 predicts functional impact of variants (incl. BRCA1, noncoding pathogenic) zero-shot and designs genome-scale sequences.
AlphaGenome beats top external models on 22/24 single-sequence and 24/26 variant-effect evaluations; not for personal disease-trait prediction.
STATE improves perturbation discrimination >50% and roughly doubles DE-gene identification accuracy vs prior models.
C2S-Scale (27B) predicted a CK2-inhibitor + low-dose interferon combo that was wet-lab validated to turn tumors from cold to hot.
Genomic-FM aggregate leaderboards are unstable; rankings flip across categories and scaling gives only modest inconsistent gains.
Single-cell foundation/DL models fail to beat simple linear/additive baselines on perturbation prediction.
On assay-level virtual-cell tasks, zero-shot generalist LLMs beat biology-specific LLMs and trainable baselines, all far from ceiling.
Biomni generalizes across biomedical tasks without task-specific tuning; adopted by >15,000 scientists in 9 months.
The AI co-scientist proposed AML drug-repurposing and fibrosis targets subsequently validated in vitro / in organoids.
Robin autonomously identified ripasudil (ROCK inhibitor) as a candidate for dry age-related macular degeneration.
TxAgent reasons over 211 tools (ToolUniverse + ToolRAG) and beats DeepSeek-R1 671B on therapeutic-reasoning tasks.
